many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

complete = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9]

def spiral_fill(n, values):
    grid = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    top, bottom, left, right = 0, n-1, 0, n-1
    num = 0
    while top <= bottom and left <= right:
        if num >= len(values): break
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            if num < len(values):
                grid[top][c] = values[num]
                num += 1
        top += 1
        if num >= len(values): break
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            if num < len(values):
                grid[r][right] = values[num]
                num += 1
        right -= 1
        if num >= len(values): break
        for c in range(right, left - 1, -1):
            if num < len(values):
                grid[bottom][c] = values[num]
                num += 1
        bottom -= 1
        if num >= len(values): break
        for r in range(bottom, top - 1, -1):
            if num < len(values):
                grid[r][left] = values[num]
                num += 1
        left += 1
    return grid
